content:
- User: nkt, macOS, zsh, Node v24.12.0
- Ruflo v3.5.2 installed globally (also as claude-flow)
- VPS deployment planned — all projects should use Ruflo with agents
- MCP servers active: claude-flow, ruv-swarm, flow-nexus, deepwiki

- Global CLAUDE.md at `~/.claude/projects/-Users-nkt/CLAUDE.md` — applies to all projects
- Global settings at `~/.claude/settings.json` — full ruflo hooks, permissions, swarm config
- Project init script: `~/.claude/scripts/ruflo-init-project.sh`
- Batch init script: `~/.claude/scripts/ruflo-init-all-projects.sh`
- Default swarm: hierarchical topology, 8 agents, specialized strategy, raft consensus

- Projects primarily in ~/dev/ directory
- Uses multiple languages: TypeScript, Rust, Go, Python
- Works on web3/solana, mobile (React Native), web apps, bots
- Has superpowers plugin, frontend-design plugin enabled
- Prefers high effort level

Android port of Windows Sales Copilot desktop app (`/Users/nkt/Last/Sales-Copilot/`).
AI real-time B2B sales coaching assistant using OpenAI GPT-4o Realtime API.

- Android project: `/Users/nkt/AndroidStudioProjects/SalesCopilot/`
- Original Windows app: `/Users/nkt/Last/Sales-Copilot/Sales-Copilot/Sales-Copilot/`
- Design doc: `docs/plans/2026-02-24-sales-copilot-android-design.md`
- Implementation plan: `docs/plans/2026-02-24-sales-copilot-android-implementation.md`
- Package: `com.example.sales_copilot`

- Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Material Design 3
- ForegroundService for audio (survives screen lock)
- AudioRecord (mic) + AudioPlaybackCapture (VoIP loopback, API 29+)
- OkHttp WebSocket → OpenAI GPT-4o Realtime API
- StateFlow for UI state, ViewModel, Coroutines
- minSdk 29 (required for AudioPlaybackCapture)

- `MainActivity` → requests permissions, launches MediaProjection intent, starts service
- `SalesCopilotService` (ForegroundService) → all audio + WebSocket logic
- `SalesCopilotViewModel` → StateFlow bridge to UI
- `OpenAIRealtimeClient` → OkHttp WebSocket to `wss://api.openai.com/v1/realtime`
- `AudioCaptureManager` → AudioRecord + AudioPlaybackCapture
- `AudioProcessor` → PCM16 conversion to 16kHz mono

Hardcoded as buildConfigField in `app/build.gradle.kts`:
`buildConfigField("String", "OPENAI_API_KEY", "\"YOUR_KEY\"")`
Referenced as `BuildConfig.OPENAI_API_KEY` in `Constants.kt`.

- Model: `gpt-4o-realtime-preview`
- Modalities: text-only (no audio output)
- Server-side VAD: threshold 0.5, silence 600ms
- Transcription: whisper-1
- Max tip length: 25 words, starts with "Quick Tip:"

- AGP: 9.0.1, Kotlin: 2.0.21, compileSdk: 36
- `compileSdk = 36` (not the `release(36)` syntax — that caused issues)
- libs.versions.toml for all dependency versions

- Background: `#0A0C14`, Surface: `#1A1D2E`
- Cyan: `#00D4FF`, Purple: `#8B5CF6`, Blue: `#3B82F6`
- Tip color: `#10B981` (green), System: `#F59E0B` (yellow)
Plan written 2026-02-24. Implementation not yet started.
